meaning.en: Having standing and a good reputation in the community.
meaning.zh: 有名望、有地位，在人面前有面子。

examples.zh: 他是镇上有头有脸的人物。
examples.en: He's a person of standing in the town.

examples.zh: 来参加婚礼的都是有头有脸的人。
examples.en: Everyone at the wedding was somebody important.

usage.zh: 多作定语，如“有头有脸的人”。

meaning.en: Having a mind as open as a valley; very modest and ready to accept advice.
meaning.zh: 胸怀像山谷一样空旷，形容非常谦虚，能容纳别人的意见。

examples.zh: 越是有成就的人，越要虚怀若谷。
examples.en: The more accomplished a person is, the more open-minded he should be.

examples.zh: 他虚怀若谷，乐于听取批评。
examples.en: He's modest and happy to hear criticism.

meaning.en: To treat something as ordinary and unimportant.
meaning.zh: 把它看成平常的事，不重视。

examples.zh: 这种病看似平常，却不可等闲视之。
examples.en: The illness seems ordinary but shouldn't be taken lightly.

examples.zh: 食品安全问题不容等闲视之。
examples.en: Food safety can't be treated as a minor matter.

usage.en: Usually negated: 不可/不能等闲视之.
usage.zh: 多用否定式“不可等闲视之”。

natural: a world of hustle and noise

meaning.en: Chaotic and full of disturbances.
meaning.zh: 形容事情或思绪杂乱，多有纷争和烦扰。

examples.zh: 离开了城市里纷纷扰扰的生活，他心里平静多了。
examples.en: Away from the hustle of city life, he felt much calmer.

examples.zh: 世间纷纷扰扰，不如静心读书。
examples.en: The world is full of noise, so better to read quietly.

meaning.en: Head connected to tail; joined end to end.
meaning.zh: 头尾互相连接，也指前后呼应、连成一体。

examples.zh: 长长的车队首尾相连，一眼望不到头。
examples.en: The long line of cars stretched end to end beyond sight.

examples.zh: 文章结构严密，首尾相连。
examples.en: The article is tightly structured, with beginning and end echoing each other.

meaning.en: To be superficially polite and accommodating without any sincerity.
meaning.zh: 对人敷衍应付，假意殷勤，并无诚意。

examples.zh: 他对客户只是虚与委蛇，并没有真正合作的意思。
examples.en: He only humoured the client and had no real intention to cooperate.

examples.zh: 面对上司的盘问，她虚与委蛇了几句。
examples.en: Faced with her boss's questioning, she fobbed him off with a few polite words.

story.en: Zhuangzi: Hu Zi says 'I showed him an emptiness and complied' (吾与之虚而委蛇), meaning he accommodated without revealing his real self.
story.zh: 《庄子》：“吾与之虚而委蛇，不知其谁何。”

meaning.en: To scramble for power and profit.
meaning.zh: 争夺权力和利益。

equivalents: a scramble for power and gain

examples.zh: 公司高层为了争权夺利闹得不可开交。
examples.en: The executives squabbled endlessly over power and profit.

examples.zh: 他看不惯办公室里争权夺利的风气。
examples.en: He disliked the culture of power-grabbing in the office.

natural: share the fun with the people

meaning.en: For those in authority to enjoy themselves together with ordinary people.
meaning.zh: 君主或官员和百姓一起欢乐。

equivalents: share the joy with the public

examples.zh: 春节期间，市里举办庙会，与民同乐。
examples.en: During the Spring Festival the city held a temple fair for everyone to enjoy together.

examples.zh: 音乐会免费开放，与民同乐。
examples.en: The concert was free, a celebration for all.

natural: master of both Chinese and Western learning

meaning.en: Deeply learned in both Chinese and Western scholarship.
meaning.zh: 精通中国和西方的学问。

equivalents: versed in both East and West
learned in Chinese and Western thought

examples.zh: 钱锺书先生学贯中西，著作等身。
examples.en: Mr Qian Zhongshu was learned in both Chinese and Western scholarship, and wrote prolifically.

examples.zh: 这位教授学贯中西，讲课旁征博引。
examples.en: The professor is at home in both traditions and lectures with wide-ranging references.

meaning.en: Monstrous crimes of the gravest kind.
meaning.zh: 极其严重、罪大恶极的罪行。

examples.zh: 法庭宣判了这伙匪徒的滔天罪行。
examples.en: The court passed judgment on the gang's monstrous crimes.

examples.zh: 他犯下滔天罪行，难逃法网。
examples.en: Having committed heinous crimes, he cannot escape the law.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，用于新闻、法律语境。

meaning.en: To have a name or reputation with nothing to back it up.
meaning.zh: 只有空名声，没有真才实学。

equivalents: a reputation with nothing behind it

examples.zh: 这家老字号早已徒有虚名。
examples.en: This old brand has long been a name and nothing more.

examples.zh: 他的头衔不少，却徒有虚名。
examples.en: He has plenty of titles but they're empty.

meaning.en: Water and sky blending into one colour.
meaning.zh: 水面和天空连成一片，颜色相同。

examples.zh: 远眺湖面，水天一色，美不胜收。
examples.en: Looking across the lake, water and sky merged into one, breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.zh: 清晨的海边，水天一色。
examples.en: At dawn on the shore, sea and sky share a single colour.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于描写景色。

meaning.en: Clear in what one loves and what one hates; taking a firm stand.
meaning.zh: 喜爱什么、憎恨什么，态度十分鲜明。

examples.zh: 她性格爽朗，爱憎分明。
examples.en: She's open-hearted and clear about her likes and dislikes.

examples.zh: 这部电影里的人物爱憎分明。
examples.en: The characters in the film show clear loves and hatreds.

meaning.en: To depend on each other in life and death.
meaning.zh: 在生死关头也相互依靠，形容关系极为亲密。

equivalents: stand by each other come what may

examples.zh: 他们夫妻几十年生死相依。
examples.en: The couple have stood by each other through everything for decades.

examples.zh: 战友之间生死相依。
examples.en: Comrades-in-arms rely on one another in life and death.

meaning.en: Two desirable things that cannot both be had; one must choose.
meaning.zh: 比喻两样都想要却不能同时得到的东西。

equivalents: having to choose between two good things
you can't have your cake and eat it

examples.zh: 事业和家庭，常常是鱼与熊掌，难以兼得。
examples.en: Career and family are often like fish and bear's paw: hard to have both.

examples.zh: 鱼与熊掌不可兼得，你得做出选择。
examples.en: You can't have both; you must choose.

story.en: Mencius: 'I want fish and I also want bear's paw; if I cannot have both, I will give up the fish and take the bear's paw' (鱼，我所欲也；熊掌，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍鱼而取熊掌者也), used to illustrate choosing righteousness over life.
story.zh: 《孟子》：“鱼，我所欲也；熊掌，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍鱼而取熊掌者也。”

usage.en: Often 鱼与熊掌不可兼得.
usage.zh: 常说“鱼与熊掌不可兼得”。

meaning.en: The hospitality a host owes to visitors.
meaning.zh: 当地人招待外来客人的情谊。

examples.zh: 你到了北京，让我尽一尽地主之谊。
examples.en: Now you're in Beijing, let me play host.

examples.zh: 他请我们吃饭，算是尽地主之谊。
examples.en: He treated us to dinner, doing his duty as host.

meaning.en: To win right from the first battle; to succeed at the outset.
meaning.zh: 军旗一展开就取得胜利，比喻事情一开始就顺利成功。

equivalents: get off to a winning start

examples.zh: 祝你们旗开得胜，马到成功！
examples.en: Wishing you an immediate triumph and swift success!

examples.zh: 球队首场比赛旗开得胜。
examples.en: The team won its very first match.

usage.en: Predicate; often a good wish, paired with 马到成功.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“马到成功”连用作祝愿。

meaning.en: Overturning rivers and seas; tremendous force or power.
meaning.zh: 形容水势或力量非常浩大，声势惊人。

examples.zh: 台风来袭，海面翻江倒海。
examples.en: As the typhoon struck, the sea churned and roared.

examples.zh: 胃里翻江倒海，难受极了。
examples.en: My stomach was churning horribly.

natural: turn the tables and take charge

meaning.en: For a guest to take over the role of host; to turn from passive to active.
meaning.zh: 客人反过来成为主人，比喻变被动为主动。

examples.zh: 下半场客队反客为主，压制了对手。
examples.en: In the second half the visitors seized control and pinned the home side back.

examples.zh: 他谈判时反客为主，掌握了节奏。
examples.en: In the negotiation he took charge and set the pace.

story.en: 'Turn the guest into the host', the thirty-first of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: take the initiative step by step so as to gain control.
story.zh: 三十六计第三十一计：“乘隙插足，扼其主机，渐之进也。”

usage.en: Predicate; one of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，三十六计之一。

meaning.en: Popular, down-to-earth art or songs, as opposed to refined art.
meaning.zh: 战国时楚国流行的通俗歌曲，后泛指通俗的文学艺术。

examples.zh: 阳春白雪和下里巴人各有各的欣赏者。
examples.en: Refined art and popular art each have their own audiences.

examples.zh: 这首歌虽是下里巴人，却深受大众喜爱。
examples.en: The song may be popular fare but is dearly loved by the public.

story.en: Song Yu's reply to the King of Chu: when a singer performed 'Xia Li Ba Ren' thousands in the capital joined in, but only a few could join the refined 'Yang Chun Bai Xue'.
story.zh: 宋玉《对楚王问》：“客有歌于郢中者，其始曰《下里巴人》，国中属而和者数千人。”

usage.en: Often paired with 阳春白雪.

natural: hold all power in one's hands

meaning.en: To monopolise authority personally.
meaning.zh: 一个人把大权全部掌握在手里。

examples.zh: 公司的创始人大权独揽，不愿放权。
examples.en: The founder holds all power and won't delegate.

examples.zh: 他在家族企业里大权独揽。
examples.en: He holds all the power in the family firm.

meaning.en: What is said is reasonable.
meaning.zh: 说的话有道理。

examples.zh: 你说得言之有理，我同意。
examples.en: What you say makes sense and I agree.

examples.zh: 他的发言言之有理，大家都点了点头。
examples.en: His speech made sense and everyone nodded.

meaning.en: What one does habitually comes to feel natural.
meaning.zh: 养成习惯以后，就觉得很自然了。

examples.zh: 每天早起跑步，习惯成自然，现在不跑反而不舒服。
examples.en: Running early every day has become second nature; now I feel off if I don't.

examples.zh: 坏习惯也是习惯成自然，要及早改掉。
examples.en: Bad habits also become second nature, so change them early.

usage.en: Saying; stands alone as a clause.
